mechanistic_inference: A memory-derived zero used as CSEL condition leaves a true data dependency from current bucket descendants load to next-key selection/hash/prefetch. A predicted absent branch plus constant-false consumer or directly branch-split miss can compute oldkey XOR missing_bit and begin next lookup before current bucket data returns. This can plausibly recover speculative overlap on roughly1/3 absent requests; no PMU measurement establishes the actual stall or recovery.

minimal_controls.constant_false: At each actual absence completion, output-only bool inline asm: bool zero; asm volatile("mov %w0, wzr" : "=r"(zero)); found=zero; return true. One W-register MOV, no input, memory clobber or early-clobber. Verify no extra bool normalization and no descendant input dependency. Diagnostic only.
minimal_controls.branch_consumer: Common canonical consume: if(found){asm volatile(""::"r"(value));sum+=value;++hits;key=value;}else{sum+=value;key^=missing_bit;}--remaining. Qualify actual false path direct EOR/hash and no joined memory-derived CSEL; lookup kernel unchanged.
